_purpose: CONTINUITY's C-lane deliverable for the overnight rarity board (Kim 2026-07-11 brief, item 2): the checkpoint-BRACKETING JUDGMENT across every trained model. Default bracket = {ep0/1, mid, last}; OVERRIDDEN per model from our findings (HoF + journals + WORKLOG) so the 9-render-per-ckpt matrix (CFG{1,7,16}xstrength{0.6,1.0,1.5}) does not burn GPU on known-dead epochs. G maps picks->render jobs; W's model_matrix.html lights up ckpts with renders done.
_consumes: rarity_gen.py matrix (G owns) + model_matrix.html column/row dropdowns (W owns)
_default_rule: ep0_or_ep1 + ep_mid + ep_last unless a finding names a winner or a dead zone

_tiers.full: healthy across the run OR a headline comparison -> render even 3-pick bracket
_tiers.early: finding says EARLY epochs win / collapse late -> weight picks early, 1 late witness
_tiers.minimal: weak/negative-leaning model -> 2 picks just for board completeness
_tiers.negative: known-bad result -> 1-2 picks to SHOW the failure, do not sweep deep
